summary.text: Su Qi Han is Chancellor Su's daughter in Profound Literature grotto-heaven, graceful and cultured, and she oversees the ten great scholars selection.

claims.text: She is the current imperial minister’s daughter. She is graceful, beautiful, cultured, and elegant. Besides her beauty, she is most praised for her literary talent: her mind is filled with poems and she has a good knowledge of the historical records, putting most men to shame. She is Chancellor Su’s daughter and is in charge of the current ten great scholars selection competition. Chancellor Su is a rank six Gu Immortal, and she is a predetermined future official of the Imperial Court. She has rank five peak stage cultivation. Shark Bandit and Medicine Demon address her as Lady Su. She tells her maid that choosing the ten great scholars is not just an imperial edict but also concerns her clan’s prosperity.
She is graceful, beautiful, cultured, and elegant.
Later, in the capital, narration again calls her a beautiful girl, and her beautiful watery eyes reveal delicate concern.

After an aphrodisiac assault by Shark Bandit and Medicine Demon leaves her unconscious, Li Xiao Bai carries her to shore. She wakes, presses him down, and after three days and three nights says she will take responsibility.

Li Xiao Bai later tells Teacher Jiang that Lady Su Qi Han tested him and informed him he will become one of the ten great scholars. Teacher Jiang has heard of this junior Su Qi Han as having immense talent and a prideful nature, and judges that she wants Li Xiao Bai to marry into her clan. Her father is the Court’s Chancellor Su.

Narration later recalls that Li Xiao Bai received the affection of Su clan’s young miss, Su Qi Han, became one of the ten great scholars, and had a chance to become that clan’s son-in-law. After hearing of his situation she went to look for him and went missing for a stretch.

After Li Xiao Bai obtains Book House inheritance and returns to the capital, she invites him to stay temporarily in her clan. The two spend almost every day in the book house cultivating and researching. Although they have not been officially engaged, she already treats him as her sole lifelong partner. She guards him personally while he changes his vital Gu to Poetry Gu, and she has hinted that marrying into and living in her clan would let him obtain that clan’s Calligraphy Immortal cultivation technique. She is her clan’s most beloved daughter, with astonishing aptitude and talents, and it is natural for her to contact that clan’s immortal cultivation technique.

When Li Xiao Bai undergoes tribulation, she shouts for her father to help him, charges toward his cocoon, then holds confidence that he can recite a poem to change the situation. After he succeeds, she sprints to him and calls him her husband. Li Xiao Bai tells Imperial Minister Su he will protect Han Er.
